scope: schematic SENSE/WRITE composition with one shared static control bit

limiting_incompatibility.ff_cold: requires the extra-8x code-1 epoch: 595.7 ps SENSE, 127.3 ps WRITE, 620.7 ps SENSE-to-WRITE delay, 25.1 ps dead time
limiting_incompatibility.ff_hot: extra-8x gives 736.9 ps SENSE-to-WRITE delay and 236.1 ps dead time; the closest extra-2x gives 654.3 ps and 153.5 ps
limiting_incompatibility.shared_bit_problem: the same bit currently chooses pulse interval/edge behavior and epoch, but FF/cold and FF/hot need the same interval code with different epochs

conclusion: Reject all one-bit joint candidates before layout. Add an orthogonal static epoch bit: retain interval/edge code 1 for both FF environments, choose a long epoch at FF/cold and a short epoch at FF/hot, and retain code 0 at SS/hot.
